description: This file defines the CurrentVersionAPI class, a REST controller handling API requests related to retrieving and setting the current version of the software during the upgrade process in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CurrentVersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller that manages retrieval and updating of the current version information within the upgrade process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current software version, either from the in-memory state or the database, and manages conflict responses if database info is missing.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set or update the current software version in the system state.
